Ok, the second hot page is also broken. This is weirdly hilarious! The workaround is to add a dummy parameter to the URL. You can use this userscript with GreaseMonkey. It will add 'nc' dummy to Voat's pagination links and hot/new/top buttons.


// ==UserScript==
// @name VoatPagination
// @namespace VoatPagination
// @include https://voat.co/*
// @version 1.1
// @grant none
// ==/UserScript==

var pg1 = document.querySelectorAll('li.btn-whoaverse-paging > a:nth-child(1)');
var pg2 = document.querySelectorAll('li.btn-whoaverse-paging:nth-child(2) > a:nth-child(1)');

if( typeof pg1[0] != 'undefined' ) {
 pg1[0].href = pg1[0].href + '&nc'
}
if( typeof pg2[0] != 'undefined' ) {
 pg2[0].href = pg2[0].href + '&nc'
}

// hot, new, top
var tm = document.querySelectorAll('.selected,.disabled');
for(var i=0; i<3; i++) {
 tm[i].childNodes[0].href += '?nc';
}
